# Vendor Agreement

## Insurance and Liability

Vendors must carry liability insurance of at least one million dollars. This requirement
is waived for vendors operating under a signed master agreement. Vendors must report any
claims within 30 days of an incident.

## Governing Law

All contracts are governed by the laws of the State of Delaware. Vendor contracts within
the European Union are instead governed by Irish law. Disputes must be resolved through
binding arbitration.~
